scope: Single AF_XDP-enabled kernel from initial Linux setup and compatibility of existing programs; new networking lesson implementation is reviewed separately.

source_review.compatibility: No changes to existing example sources justified. XDP_SOCKETS makes an AF_XDP socket family available; it neither attaches an XDP program nor changes normal packet delivery. Existing GPIOv2, I2C_RDWR, serial termios/poll, memory syscalls and module APIs remain the same at the exact source revision. Pico builds are independent of Linux.

repairs_reviewed: Replace nonexistent custom-release APT headers and package-provenance queries with completed native source/output tree and source/config record.
Use full kernel Image/modules/dtbs build and Module.symvers; do not substitute modules_prepare or install x86 host tools on Pi.
Bind module and overlay artifacts to build report; reject dirty source and mismatched config/release.
Select private image, DTB and overlays before any original dtoverlay directives; leave cmdline and stock recovery files intact.
Preserve exact byte backup; disable stock auto_initramfs for narrowly checked direct ext4 microSD root.
Include hidden .config in CI evidence and archive all native build/install contract files.
Require explicit empty LOCALVERSION for every reader kbuild query/build/clean, preventing appended + and subsequent module ABI drift.
Verify installed Image/DTB/overlays, module presence/dependency index and both symlinks before claiming no-op; refuse corrupt installations.
Recovery docs no longer promise rerunning the refusing installer automatically repairs partial/moved build trees.
